PHASE.NAME: CI/CD Pipeline + Production Baseline
PHASE.GOAL: Initialize Git repository, create `.github/workflows/ci.yml` with full workspace pipeline (check → test → clippy → bench → verify → release-dry), and establish the first green CI run as the production quality baseline.
PHASE.SOURCE: Honest assessment gap #1: no CI/CD, no git repo, no automated quality gates. Every check runs manually. This is the #1 blocker to production readiness.

DELIVERABLES.DELIVERABLE: Git init + .gitignore audit (target/, node_modules/, coverage/, *.db, .env, opencode.jsonc)
`.github/workflows/ci.yml` — full pipeline: checkout → build → test --workspace → clippy → fmt-check → bench --no-run → verify → refresh → release-dry
`.github/workflows/release.yml` — on tag v*: build-release → tarpaulin → package → smoke-test → upload-artifacts
First green CI run on push — all gates pass OR documented known failures (e2e×2, traceability advisory)

DATA_FLOWS.FLOW: Push to main → CI trigger → cargo check --workspace → cargo test --workspace → cargo clippy → cargo fmt --check
CI → cargo bench --no-run (verify bench compile) → cargo run -- verify → cargo run -- refresh --fix
Tag v* → release trigger → cargo build --release → cargo tarpaulin → tarball + SHA256 → upload to GitHub Releases

VERIFICATION.CHECK: CI passes on push: check ✅, test ✅ (e2e skipped), clippy ✅, fmt ✅
Bench targets compile in CI (cargo bench --no-run)
GRACE verify passes in CI (wave ✅, phase ✅)
Release workflow dry-run succeeds on tag

RISKS.RISK: GitHub Actions macOS runner may not have Rust 1.95.0. Mitigation: use rust-toolchain.toml or actions-rs/toolchain.
E2E tests require syn binary in PATH — will fail in CI. Mitigation: skip e2e in CI, add `cargo install --path .` step.
cargo-tarpaulin may timeout on GitHub Actions (2-core limit). Mitigation: use --skip-clean, limit to --workspace --exclude-files.
